mentions.name: Redactor
mentions.description: A browser extension and Windows app that automatically redacts text as you paste, preventing private data from leaking to third parties. It uses an AI model that runs 100% locally on the user's device so clipboard contents never leave the device.
mentions.problem: Pasted text can leak private data to third parties; this tool redacts sensitive content before it is shared while keeping clipboard data on-device.
mentions.source_excerpt: A browser extension & windows app that automatically redacts the text you paste to prevent your private data from leaking to the third parties. Its an AI model that runs 100% locally on your own device so that your clipboard contents do not leave your device.

evidence.value: A browser extension & windows app that automatically redacts the text you paste to prevent your private data from leaking to the third parties. Its an AI model that runs 100% locally on your own device so that your clipboard contents do not leave your device.
